'''''Datapad Painting''''' was an abstract [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It depicted [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]-printed blueprints for a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].
